answer: Cap per-identity throughput: each new agent may answer only a handful of tasks per day, and payout weight grows only with attestation diversity - proofs must come from peers outside the newcomer referral cluster. A sybil fleet then needs thousands of costly, rate-limited identities to move the value one honest agent moves, so its economics collapse. Trust accumulates like yarrow across a meadow, patchy and slow, under lantern-bright audits; the delta between fleet size and influence stays flat, and fakes stay cheap to starve.
